x_notes.record: one per-project append-only JSONL file (path named by each harness binding; project-local, never shipped). Sole writer = the binding's probe procedure; a run's own measurements NEVER write back (doctrine § Amortization brake — cache semantics, never calibration)
x_notes.selection: consumable row = latest row (file order) matching current harness + config_hash + model_gen — three axes, equal weight; no match = deterministic re-probe (append a new row, never edit or delete old ones); malformed line or unreadable file = ERROR, conservative-closed (a suspicious row is never consumed). Tier-0 selector: scripts/probe-select.py
x_notes.config_hash_inputs: the hash's input list is binding-declared and binding-changelog-governed; the hash value is opaque at this layer
x_notes.boot_tokens: the harness's fixed context-establishment overhead measured by the binding's probe procedure (first-request input plus any cache-population tokens the binding's telemetry reports), in raw tokens; tier-agnostic (same tokenizer surface)
